command: for s in 29d816ac550b7ece RF8M21J8XRT RF8M90QE7LX; do echo "===== $s props ====="; timeout 10 adb -s "$s" shell getprop ro.product.model; timeout 10 adb -s "$s" shell getprop ro.build.version.release; echo "===== $s wearable/meta packages ====="; timeout 15 adb -s "$s" shell pm list packages | grep -Ei "facebook|meta|oculus|stella|samsung.android.app.watch|wear|galaxy|health" || true; echo "===== $s bluetooth pairing hints ====="; timeout 20 adb -s "$s" shell dumpsys bluetooth_manager | grep -Ei "ray|ban|meta|galaxy|watch|wear|buds|rb|name|bond|connected" | head -200 || true; done

s=RF8M21J8XRT; echo "===== $s focused packages ====="; timeout 15 adb -s "$s" shell pm list packages | grep -Ei "hydracam|keepeyeonball|stella|facebook|meta|watchmanager|wear|health" || true; echo "===== $s companion device associations ====="; timeout 15 adb -s "$s" shell dumpsys companiondevice || true; echo "===== $s developer settings ====="; timeout 10 adb -s "$s" shell settings get global adb_enabled; timeout 10 adb -s "$s" shell settings get global adb_wifi_enabled; timeout 10 adb -s "$s" shell settings get global development_settings_enabled
